<p class="section-label">Open Research</p>

# Open Science

I share code, course work, and research tools where I can, so others can check and reuse them. Data and code from ongoing studies will follow as those projects are published.

## Research tools

**[Chota](https://ahmypeace.github.io/Chota/){target="_blank"}.** A browser app for manual content analysis. Coders read each article PDF and code it on the same screen, then export the data to SPSS, Excel, CSV, R, or Python. [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/ahmypeace/Chota){target="_blank"}

## Course portfolios

**[NLP in R](https://ahmypeace.github.io/CSD5730_NLP_R_Spring2026/){target="_blank"}.** Text cleaning, corpus analysis, dictionary methods, psycholinguistic norms, and semantic distance in R, with every report and its R Markdown source. [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/ahmypeace/CSD5730_NLP_R_Spring2026){target="_blank"}

**[GIS Lab Portfolio](https://ahmypeace.github.io/gis-lab-report/){target="_blank"}.** Maps of drinking-water risk in Flint, schools near methane-producing landfills in Los Angeles, and a site search for a healthy food store in Philadelphia, made in ArcGIS Pro. [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/ahmypeace/gis-lab-report){target="_blank"}

## This website

This site is built with Quarto, and its [source is on GitHub](https://github.com/ahmypeace/ahmypeace.github.io){target="_blank"}.
